summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a non-binding letter of intent (LOI) with Alpha Future Funds S.C.S. to combine their wholly-owned subsidiaries in the Sulitjelma mining district, Norway. The LOI contemplates up to a four-month due diligence period. No specific financial terms, premium, or advisor are disclosed. This is a preliminary, non-binding agreement to consolidate exploration assets, not yet a formal acquisition. The filing is a foreign private issuer report and does not constitute a definitive M&A event. The development remains subject to negotiation and definitive agreement.
